idea-plugin.name: LogParser Pro
idea-plugin.description:
LogParser Pro — Advanced Log Analysis and Monitoring in Your IDE

Stop switching between your IDE and log viewers. LogParser Pro brings professional log analysis directly into your JetBrains IDE with syntax highlighting, real-time tailing, pattern matching, correlation tracking, and AI-powered anomaly detection for faster debugging.

Log Analysis

  • Syntax Highlighting — Color-coded log levels (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE) for JSON, plaintext, and common formats
  • Log Level Filtering — Filter entries by severity with one-click filtering
  • Pattern Matching — Regex-based search with saved patterns and auto-detection of Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and Java formats
  • Stack Trace Folding — Collapse exception traces for readability
  • Dedicated Log Editor — Custom editor for .log, .txt, and .out files with built-in tools

Real-Time Monitoring

  • Kubernetes and Docker Integration — Native kubectl logs and Docker API for container log tailing
  • SSH Remote Tailing — Connect to remote servers for live log monitoring
  • Multi-Source Monitoring — Tail 10+ log sources simultaneously with RxJava streaming
  • Alerting Engine — Real-time notifications when specific patterns appear

Distributed Systems

  • Correlation ID Tracking — Follow request flows across microservices
  • AI Anomaly Detection — ML-based pattern detection using Isolation Forest algorithm
  • Advanced Filtering — Composite filters with AND/OR/NOT logic
  • Team Collaboration — Shared queries, annotations, and JIRA/Slack integration

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 232+)
  • JDK 17+
  • Kubernetes plugin (optional — for Kubernetes log support)

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Documentation
